query:
INSERT INTO reports (
             created_at, reported_by, reason_type, reason,
             subject_type, subject_did, subject_uri, subject_cid, status,
             decoded_plaintext, decode_source
         )
         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8, 'pending', ?9, ?10)
         RETURNING id as "id!: i64"
